title: Overdraft / NSF Fee Recomputation
description: Independently recomputes overdraft (OD) and non-sufficient-funds (NSF) fee events from a caller-pasted posted-transaction ledger, an opening balance, a declared posting-order policy, and a declared fee schedule, then diffs the recomputed fee totals against caller-supplied core-charged fees. Posting order and every fee-schedule term are caller-declared, never chosen or inferred.

account_token.description: Opaque caller-supplied account token or hash, never a real account number

ledger.description: Posted transaction rows: txn_id, post_date, effective_date, txn_type, amount, settle_negative_allowed, representment_of

fee_schedule.description: nsf_fee_minor_units, od_fee_minor_units, daily_fee_cap_count, representment_dedup_days, extended_overdrawn_days, extended_overdrawn_fee_minor_units

core_charged_fees.description: post_date, fee_type (NSF|OD|EXTENDED_OD), amount_minor_units — what the core actually charged, to diff against

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_odnsf_fee_recompute
mcp_tool_definition.description: Recomputes overdraft and NSF fee events from a posted-transaction ledger under a declared posting-order policy and fee schedule, diffed against core-charged fees. Independent recompute and receipt, not a core alternative or vendor audit.

fee_schedule.description: Declared fee amounts, caps, dedup and extended-overdrawn terms

core_charged_fees.description: What the core actually charged, to diff against
